svg.title: Who does what: the responsibility matrix
svg.desc: Each activity of the lifecycle by role, grouped by function: who signs off, who is accountable, who does the work, who is consulted and who is informed.
svg.text: WHO DOES WHAT: THE RESPONSIBILITY MATRIX
Each activity by role. The darker the cell, the more the role carries; a sign-off is a decision the activity cannot pass without.
Register an asset and its connections
Risk, criticality and process impact assessment
DPIA and records of processing, where required
Security testing and red teaming; validation of
Change triage; materiality of a change
Minimum controls per level of autonomy
Read from the table of 5.4; roles regrouped by function. [privacy] = the privacy function.
